stem: Meena, a Class 7 student in Pune, washes daily, keeps herself clean during her menstrual cycle, and wraps used sanitary pads before putting them in the dustbin. Why are these habits described as good health practices?

options.text: They make a person look neat, which is the only purpose of hygiene.
They protect her body from infection and also keep the community environment clean.
They are needed only in the armpits and pubic region during adolescence.
They matter only when a person already has an infection.

teacher.key_rationale: Daily washing, menstrual hygiene, and wrapped disposal of used pads reduce infection risk for the individual and maintain community health and environmental cleanliness, so B is correct. A reduces hygiene to appearance, C wrongly restricts hygiene to two body regions, and D wrongly requires an existing infection.
